Your Recommendations

Dr. Sameer Sanghvi

General Practitioner (GP)
GMC no. 7085078

Consultation overview:

Your hair loss is consistent with male pattern hair loss
You're new to hair loss treatment

Our recommendation:

You're suitable for Finasteride tablets, Minoxidil tablets and Minoxidil spray
As you're new to hair loss treatment, we'd recommend starting with a licensed treatment, such as Finasteride tablets and Minoxidil spray
Combining Finasteride with Minoxidil may provide greater benefits than using either treatment alone, as they work in different ways.
Combination Treatments
Our most effective hair loss treament. Combine the benefits of two proven hair loss treatments.
Read More
Dual Action - Tablet + Spray
Finasteride 1mg tablet + Minoxidil 5% spray
94% experience an improvement in hair loss¹
From £7.35 a week
Details:
Daily tablet & twice daily spray
Helps prevent further hair loss and encourages thicker, fuller looking hair
Includes targeted treatment
Important:
Ensure pets do not come into contact with topical minoxidil
Finasteride tablets must not be handled by pregnant women.
Licensed for hair loss
Learn more
Dual Action - Tablets
Finasteride 1mg tablet + Minoxidil 2.5mg tablet
We recommend as an oral alternative to the classic combo
From £7.35 a week
Details:
Convenient daily tablets
Helps prevent further hair loss and encourages thicker, fuller looking hair
Important:
Finasteride tablets must not be handled by pregnant women.
Contains off-label medicine
Learn more
Other suitable treatments

1 94% showed improvement after 12 months (Hu et al., Dermatol Ther 2015)

2 83% study participants maintained or improved their hair growth over 2 years (Kaufman et al., JAAD 1998)

3 71% of study participants showed improved hair density after 16 weeks (Olsen et al., JAAD 2007)
